items.title: Air India asks why it wasn't kept in loop before police boarded flight to detain CJP leaders; seeks BCAS protocol guidelines
items.summary: Air India has asked the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS) for guidelines covering situations where police personnel enter aircraft to detain people, after Delhi Police boarded the Mumbai-Delhi flight to detain Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka on Oct 10. The airline also asked why it wasn't informed of the move in advance and under what circumstances police were permitted to board the plane (The Hindu, via inshorts).
